# U49: Set up a small workspace on a Sunday, as the outside reviewer did: each field says what it needs, a team typo is caught, nothing is late, Home shows the one team’s goals as one section, the weekly review exists, and Start over removes it all

- **Belongs to:** the Reviews module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `ONBOARDING`, `WORKSPACES`, `REVIEWS`, `CALENDAR-WEEKS`, `DEMO-MODE`, `SMALL-MENU`
- **Budget:** 30 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `budget` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/` in the demo on Sunday 8 November 2026.
